mechanism: Selegiline is a selective MAO-B inhibitor that may accumulate monoamines, and berberine has potential sympathomimetic and serotonergic properties that could theoretically increase monoamine levels and risk of hypertensive episodes or serotonin-related effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure and symptoms of excessive monoamine activity (agitation, tremor, hypertension); use with caution and inform patients to avoid tyramine-rich foods if concerned about additive effects.
